name: Inventory Portfolio Taxonomy Coverage
jtbd: When the room has a user- or host-supplied taxonomy and assigned source records, count where material is represented or thin before investigating possible gaps.
runtime: Python >=3.11; local CLI and stdio MCP
limitations: Counts representation only; it does not run original HSI embedding, PCA/UMAP, or demand analysis, and does not establish market whitespace.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.
